content.json:
# Production Website — SLO Dashboard

This laboratory dashboard evaluates the last 30 days of **observed** availability-test results. The paid test is disabled outside supervised exercises. Missing observations are **unknown**, not successful. See `docs/slo.md` and `docs/error-budget-policy.md` in the project repository for definitions and operating policy.

content.query:
let EvaluationWindow = 30d;
AppAvailabilityResults
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(EvaluationWindow)
| summarize TotalChecks=count(), FirstCheck=min(TimeGenerated), LastCheck=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend CoverageStatus=iff(TotalChecks == 0, 'UNKNOWN — no observations', strcat(TotalChecks, ' checks observed'))
| project CoverageStatus, TotalChecks, FirstCheck, LastCheck
content.title: Measurement coverage

content.json:
## Current indicators

Targets: **99.9% availability**, **95% of successful checks under 500 ms**, and **less than 1% synthetic errors**. Results are laboratory evidence only until continuous coverage is approved.

content.title: SLO evaluation

content.query:
let EvaluationWindow = 30d;
AppAvailabilityResults
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(EvaluationWindow)
| summarize P50=round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 2), P95=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 2), P99=round(percentile(DurationMs, 99), 2), Average=round(avg(DurationMs), 2)
| project P50DurationMs=P50, P95DurationMs=P95, P99DurationMs=P99, AverageDurationMs=Average
content.title: Latency percentiles

content.query:
let EvaluationWindow = 30d;
let AvailabilityObjective = 0.999;
AppAvailabilityResults
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(EvaluationWindow)
| summarize TotalChecks=count(), FailedChecks=countif(Success == false)
| extend AllowedFailedChecks=TotalChecks * (1.0 - AvailabilityObjective)
| extend RemainingFailedChecks=AllowedFailedChecks - FailedChecks
| extend RemainingBudgetPercent=iff(TotalChecks == 0, real(null), round(100.0 * RemainingFailedChecks / AllowedFailedChecks, 2))
| extend Status=case(TotalChecks == 0, 'UNKNOWN', RemainingBudgetPercent <= 0, 'EXHAUSTED', RemainingBudgetPercent <= 25, 'AT RISK', RemainingBudgetPercent <= 50, 'CAUTION', 'NORMAL')
| project TotalChecks, FailedChecks, AllowedFailedChecks=round(AllowedFailedChecks, 3), RemainingFailedChecks=round(RemainingFailedChecks, 3), RemainingBudgetPercent, Status
content.title: Availability error budget

content.query:
let EvaluationWindow = 30d;
AppAvailabilityResults
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(EvaluationWindow)
| summarize AvailabilityPercent=100.0 * countif(Success == true) / count(), AverageDurationMs=avg(DurationMs), Checks=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Observed daily availability

content.json:
## How to use this dashboard

1. Check **Measurement coverage** before interpreting any percentage.
2. Investigate any **NOT MET** or **EXHAUSTED** status using the availability runbook.
3. Do not treat a period without observations as healthy.
4. Keep the Standard availability test disabled outside an approved, supervised exercise.
